sections.content: Languages ship with libraries of ready-made functions: length, round, random, sorting, string helpers, and more. Learning the standard toolbox saves you from reinventing basics.
The exact names differ per language, but the categories are universal: string functions, math functions, collection functions, and conversion functions.
Key points: check official docs for your language's built-ins — they are faster and better tested than hand-rolled versions.
